rules.clause_label: Dual Licensing Options — non-commercial GPLv3 option
rules.scope_note: Repository source code; the stated option is for non-commercial use, including academic purposes, under GPLv3. This clause does not supply GPLv3's terms.
rules.condition_explanation: Use must be non-commercial and comply with the GPLv3 terms; those terms are referenced by URL but are not included in the supplied text.
rules.source_excerpt:
You may choose to use it under the terms of the GPLv3 for non-commercial purposes, or you can obtain a commercial license for commercial use.

For non-commercial uses and licensing of this code (which include academic purposes), an open-source licence is granted in accordance with the following terms and conditions -

GPLv3 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html)

rules.clause_label: Dual Licensing Options — commercial license option
rules.scope_note: Repository source code; commercial use is tied to obtaining a commercial license. The text does not provide that license's terms. Lines 11–14 identify contacts for commercial licensing.
rules.condition_explanation: The predicate requires that a commercial license has been obtained; the supplied text does not specify its terms or establish that any user has obtained one.
rules.source_excerpt: You may choose to use it under the terms of the GPLv3 for non-commercial purposes, or you can obtain a commercial license for commercial use.
